candidate.title: scATAC-Seq
candidate.scope: The two complete scATAC-Seq rows in the assigned Illumina poster crop: Cell index (combinatorial cellular indexing of intact nuclei, as described by Cusanovich et al. 2015) and Microfluidics (individual-cell capture in the C1 implementation described by Buenrostro et al. 2015). The genome is the DNA substrate; transposase-accessible chromatin is the biological target; adapter-bearing, indexed genomic DNA fragments are the final library carrier. The rows are alternative workflows with separate inputs and final pools. Initial Single cell/chromatin cartoons explain the target, rather than supplying an additional preparative branch. Cut-off labels from the preceding row, the partial Drop-ChIP/scChIP-seq row below, and acylation/DIBO-biotin chemistry at the right are neighboring catalogue content outside this assignment. No sequencing operation is drawn: the endpoints are DNA libraries, whose supported sequencing interpretation is recorded in their features. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete experimental protocol.
